+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.combat.attribute.RpgAttribute;
+import java.util.*;
+import java.util.stream.Stream;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Candidate equipment proof only; it does not qualify an affix's gameplay consumer. */
+class MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest {
+    private static final GearCatalog CATALOG=GearCatalog.load();
+    private static final GearAffixQaSuite QA=new GearAffixQaSuite(CATALOG);
+    private static final Map<RpgAttribute,Integer> HIGH=Map.of(RpgAttribute.STR,500,RpgAttribute.DEX,500,
+            RpgAttribute.INT,500,RpgAttribute.WIS,500,RpgAttribute.LUCK,500);
+
+    static Stream<Arguments> authoredAffixes() {
+        assertEquals(160,QA.coverage().size());
+        return QA.coverage().stream().map(row->Arguments.of(row.affixId(),row.fixtureId()));
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate equipped(GearInstance item) {
+        return new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,true);
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Result resolve(GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate... slots) {
+        return GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(slots),ALL_AUTHORED);
+    }
+    private static final Set<String> ALL_AUTHORED=authoredIds();
+    private static Set<String> authoredIds() {
+        var ids=new HashSet<String>();
+        CATALOG.affixes().forEach(a->ids.add(a.id()));
+        assertEquals(160,ids.size());
+        return Set.copyOf(ids);
+    }
+    private static void rejected(GearInstance item,String reason,GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate candidate) {
+        var result=resolve(candidate);
+        assertEquals(reason,result.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(result.validItems().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(result.effects().snapshot().empty());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,result.effects());
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} equipment admission")
+    @ValueSource(strings={
+        "WA-001","WA-002","WA-003","WA-004","WA-005","WA-006","WA-007","WA-008","WA-009","WA-010",
+        "WA-011","WA-012","WA-013","WA-014","WA-015","WA-016","WA-017","WA-018","WA-019","WA-020",
+        "WA-021","WA-022","WA-023","WA-024","WA-025","WA-026","WA-027","WA-028","WA-029","WA-030",
+        "WA-031","WA-032","WA-033","WA-034","WA-035","WA-036","WA-037","WA-038","WA-039","WA-040",
+        "WA-041","WA-042","WA-043","WA-044","WA-045","WA-046","WA-047","WA-048","WA-049","WA-050",
+        "WA-051","WA-052","WA-053","WA-054","WA-055","WA-056","WA-057","WA-058","WA-059","WA-060",
+        "WA-061","WA-062","WA-063","WA-064","WA-065","WA-066","WA-067","WA-068","WA-069","WA-070",
+        "WA-071","WA-072","WA-073","WA-074","WA-075","WA-076","WA-077","WA-078","WA-079","WA-080",
+        "WA-081","WA-082","WA-083","WA-084","WA-085","WA-086","WA-087","WA-088","WA-089","WA-090",
+        "WA-091","WA-092","WA-093","WA-094","WA-095","WA-096","WA-097","WA-098","WA-099","WA-100",
+        "WA-101","WA-102","WA-103","WA-104","WA-105","WA-106","WA-107","WA-108","WA-109","WA-110",
+        "WA-111","WA-112","WA-113","WA-114","WA-115","WA-116","WA-117","WA-118","WA-119","WA-120",
+        "WA-121","WA-122","WA-123","WA-124","WA-125","WA-126","WA-127","WA-128","WA-129","WA-130",
+        "WA-131","WA-132","WA-133","WA-134","WA-135","WA-136","WA-137","WA-138","WA-139","WA-140",
+        "WA-141","WA-142","WA-143","WA-144","WA-145","WA-146","WA-147","WA-148","WA-149","WA-150",
+        "WA-151","WA-152","WA-153","WA-154","WA-155","WA-156","WA-157","WA-158","GA-159","GA-160"
+    })
+    void authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation(String id) {
+        String fixtureId="ab-"+id.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)+"-affixed";
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var item=QA.preview(row);
+        var base=CATALOG.base(item.baseId());
+        var definition=CATALOG.affix(id);
+        var roll=assertDoesNotThrow(()->item.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(List.of(id),item.affixes().stream().map(GearInstance.AffixRoll::familyId).toList());
+        assertEquals(row.itemLevel(),item.itemLevel());
+        assertEquals(5,HIGH.size());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),item.itemLevel()),id+" source window");
+        assertEquals(definition.side(),roll.side());
+        assertEquals(definition.exclusionGroup(),roll.exclusionGroup());
+        var tier=GearAffixTiers.compile(definition).stream().filter(t->t.tier()==roll.tier()).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        assertTrue(tier.minimumItemLevel()<=item.itemLevel());
+        assertTrue(GearAffixTiers.rarityAllows(definition,tier,item.rarity()));
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.rollable(definition,base,tier));
+        assertEquals(tier.requiredLevel(),roll.requirements().level());
+        assertEquals(GearRequirements.combine(new GearRequirements.Gate(base.requiredLevel(),base.requiredAttributes()),
+                List.of(roll.requirements()),id.equals("WA-154")
+                        ?java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(roll.value()).movePointLeft(2):java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO),item.requirements());
+        if(definition.eligibility().equals("MATCH"))
+            assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.matchingSkillIds(base).contains(roll.selector()),id+" frozen selector");
+        else assertNull(roll.selector());
+
+        var accepted=resolve(equipped(item));
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),accepted.validItems());
+        assertTrue(accepted.rejected().isEmpty());
+        var snapshot=accepted.effects().snapshot();
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),snapshot.items());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id));
+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var control=QA.preview(controlRow);
+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} production carrier legality: {1}")
+    @MethodSource("authoredAffixes")
+    void authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible(String id,String fixtureId) {
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var base=CATALOG.base(row.itemBaseId());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),row.itemLevel()),id+" authored source window");
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.eligible(CATALOG.affix(id),base),id+" has no legal carrier: "+base.id());
+    }
+}

def passed_parameter_ids():
    """A parameterized row needs its own real passing XML invocation."""
    result = {}
    paths = sorted([*RESULTS.glob("TEST-*.xml"), *NATIVE_RESULTS.glob("TEST-*.xml")],
                   key=lambda path: path.stat().st_mtime)
    for path in paths:
        suite = ET.parse(path).getroot()
        for case in suite.findall("testcase"):
            name = case.get("name", "")
            key = case.get("classname", "") + "#" + name.split("(", 1)[0].split("[", 1)[0]
            for affix_id in set(ID.findall(name)):
                pair = (key, affix_id)
                if any(case.find(tag) is not None for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped")):
                    result.pop(pair, None)
                else:
                    result[pair] = path.stat().st_mtime
    return result


def registered_proofs():
    data = read_json(PROOFS)
    if data.get("schemaVersion") != 1 or not isinstance(data.get("proofs"), dict):
        raise ValueError("Invalid affix proof registry")
    return data["proofs"]


def check_proof(affix_id, proof, source_by_test, passed, parameter_passed=None):
    holes = []
    consumer = proof.get("realRuntimeConsumer")
    if not consumer or not (ROOT / consumer).is_file() or not consumer.startswith("src/main/java/"):
        holes.append("real runtime consumer missing")
        consumer_name = None
    else:
        consumer_name = Path(consumer).stem
    def fresh(test, field):
        if test not in source_by_test or test not in passed:
            return False
        timestamp = passed[test]
        anchor = proof.get("sourceAnchors", {}).get(field, {})
        if anchor.get("parameterId") and "@ValueSource" in source_by_test[test][1]:
            timestamp = (parameter_passed or {}).get((test, affix_id), -1)
        dependencies = [source_by_test[test][0]]
        dependencies.extend(ROOT / step.get("path", "") for step in anchor.get("runtimeChain", []))
        return all(path.is_file() and timestamp >= path.stat().st_mtime for path in dependencies)
    for field in ("positiveTest", "controlTest", "negativeTest", "equippedAuthorityTest"):
        test = proof.get(field)
        if not test or test not in source_by_test:
            holes.append(field + " source missing")
        elif (source := reviewed_source(affix_id, proof, field, test, source_by_test)) is None:
            holes.append(field + " does not identify affix")
        elif not ASSERTION.search(source) or (proof.get("sourceAnchors", {}).get(field)
                                              and not any(ASSERTION.search(value) for value in proof["sourceAnchors"][field].get("required", []))):
            holes.append(field + " lacks an assertion")
        elif not fresh(test, field) or (consumer_name and passed[test] < (ROOT / consumer).stat().st_mtime):
            holes.append(field + " has no passing JUnit XML")
        elif (consumer_name and field in ("positiveTest", "controlTest", "negativeTest")
              and not (invokes_consumer(source, consumer_name)
                       or reviewed_runtime_chain(proof, field, source, source_by_test[test][0], consumer))):
            holes.append(field + " does not invoke registered consumer")
    return holes


def build():
    affixes = read_json(GEAR / "affixes-v1.json")["affixes"]
    require_catalog(affixes)
    fixtures = read_json(GEAR / "affix-qa-fixtures-v1.json")["fixtures"]
    bases = {b["id"]: b for b in read_json(GEAR / "bases-v1.json")["bases"]}
    bindings = {b["baseId"]: b for b in read_json(GEAR / "native-bindings-v1.json")["bindings"]}
    enabled = enabled_ids()
    authored = {a["id"] for a in affixes}
    if enabled - authored:
        raise ValueError("Production gate contains unknown affix IDs")
    references, source_by_test = source_tests()
    candidate_consumers = source_consumers()
    sentinel_policy, sentinel_adapted = sentinel_policies()
    passed = passed_tests()
    parameter_passed = passed_parameter_ids()
    proofs = registered_proofs()
    if set(proofs) - {a["id"] for a in affixes}:
        raise ValueError("Proof registry contains unknown IDs")
    fixture_ids = {}
    fixture_carriers = {}
    seen_fixtures = set()
    for fixture in fixtures:
        if fixture["fixtureId"] in seen_fixtures:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate QA fixture ID")
        seen_fixtures.add(fixture["fixtureId"])
        for affix_id in fixture["affixIds"]:
            if affix_id not in authored:
                raise ValueError("QA fixture contains unknown affix ID")
            fixture_ids.setdefault(affix_id, []).append(fixture["fixtureId"])
            fixture_carriers.setdefault(affix_id, []).append(fixture["itemBaseId"])
    rows = []
    for affix in affixes:
        ident = affix["id"]
        proof = proofs.get(ident, {})
        holes = check_proof(ident, proof, source_by_test, passed, parameter_passed)
        if ident not in enabled:
            holes.append("production capability gate closed")
        mapped = [b["id"] for b in bases.values() if b.get("worldDropCandidate")
                  and bindings.get(b["id"], {}).get("disposition") == "MAPPED"]
        # Catalog legality is Java-owned. These are authored scopes, not a guessed
        # Python copy of GearDropGenerator. Registered legal-carrier proof is needed.
        carrier = proof.get("legalCarrier")
        if not carrier or carrier not in mapped:
            holes.append("mapped legal carrier proof missing")
        if not proof.get("legalCarrierTest") or not (proof["legalCarrierTest"] in source_by_test
                and proof["legalCarrierTest"] in passed
                and passed[proof["legalCarrierTest"]] >= source_by_test[proof["legalCarrierTest"]][0].stat().st_mtime):
            holes.append("legal carrier test missing or unpassed")
        elif proof["legalCarrierTest"] not in source_by_test or ident not in source_by_test[proof["legalCarrierTest"]][1]:
            holes.append("legal carrier test does not identify affix")
        elif carrier not in source_by_test[proof["legalCarrierTest"]][1] or "eligible(" not in source_by_test[proof["legalCarrierTest"]][1]:
            holes.append("legal carrier test does not check this base with production eligibility")
        if affix["operator"] in ADVANCED:
            view_test = proof.get("advancedStatsTest")
            if (not view_test or view_test not in source_by_test or view_test not in passed
                    or passed[view_test] < source_by_test[view_test][0].stat().st_mtime
                    or ident not in source_by_test[view_test][1]):
                holes.append("Advanced Stats comparison missing or unpassed")

+        assertTrue(result.effects().snapshot().empty());

+    void authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation(String id) {
+        String fixtureId="ab-"+id.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)+"-affixed";
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var item=QA.preview(row);
+        var base=CATALOG.base(item.baseId());
+        var definition=CATALOG.affix(id);
+        var roll=assertDoesNotThrow(()->item.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(List.of(id),item.affixes().stream().map(GearInstance.AffixRoll::familyId).toList());
+        assertEquals(row.itemLevel(),item.itemLevel());
+        assertEquals(5,HIGH.size());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),item.itemLevel()),id+" source window");
+        assertEquals(definition.side(),roll.side());
+        assertEquals(definition.exclusionGroup(),roll.exclusionGroup());
+        var tier=GearAffixTiers.compile(definition).stream().filter(t->t.tier()==roll.tier()).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        assertTrue(tier.minimumItemLevel()<=item.itemLevel());
+        assertTrue(GearAffixTiers.rarityAllows(definition,tier,item.rarity()));
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.rollable(definition,base,tier));
+        assertEquals(tier.requiredLevel(),roll.requirements().level());
+        assertEquals(GearRequirements.combine(new GearRequirements.Gate(base.requiredLevel(),base.requiredAttributes()),
+                List.of(roll.requirements()),id.equals("WA-154")
+                        ?java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(roll.value()).movePointLeft(2):java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO),item.requirements());
+        if(definition.eligibility().equals("MATCH"))
+            assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.matchingSkillIds(base).contains(roll.selector()),id+" frozen selector");
+        else assertNull(roll.selector());
+
+        var accepted=resolve(equipped(item));
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),accepted.validItems());
+        assertTrue(accepted.rejected().isEmpty());
+        var snapshot=accepted.effects().snapshot();
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),snapshot.items());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id));
+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var control=QA.preview(controlRow);
+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} production carrier legality: {1}")
+    @MethodSource("authoredAffixes")
+    void authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible(String id,String fixtureId) {
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var base=CATALOG.base(row.itemBaseId());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),row.itemLevel()),id+" authored source window");
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.eligible(CATALOG.affix(id),base),id+" has no legal carrier: "+base.id());
+    }

+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var control=QA.preview(controlRow);
+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} production carrier legality: {1}")
+    @MethodSource("authoredAffixes")
+    void authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible(String id,String fixtureId) {
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var base=CATALOG.base(row.itemBaseId());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),row.itemLevel()),id+" authored source window");
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.eligible(CATALOG.affix(id),base),id+" has no legal carrier: "+base.id());
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.combat.attribute.RpgAttribute;
+import java.util.*;
+import java.util.stream.Stream;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Candidate equipment proof only; it does not qualify an affix's gameplay consumer. */
+class MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest {
+    private static final GearCatalog CATALOG=GearCatalog.load();
+    private static final GearAffixQaSuite QA=new GearAffixQaSuite(CATALOG);
+    private static final Map<RpgAttribute,Integer> HIGH=Map.of(RpgAttribute.STR,500,RpgAttribute.DEX,500,
+            RpgAttribute.INT,500,RpgAttribute.WIS,500,RpgAttribute.LUCK,500);
+
+    static Stream<Arguments> authoredAffixes() {
+        assertEquals(160,QA.coverage().size());
+        return QA.coverage().stream().map(row->Arguments.of(row.affixId(),row.fixtureId()));
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate equipped(GearInstance item) {
+        return new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,true);
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Result resolve(GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate... slots) {
+        return GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(slots),ALL_AUTHORED);
+    }
+    private static final Set<String> ALL_AUTHORED=authoredIds();
+    private static Set<String> authoredIds() {
+        var ids=new HashSet<String>();
+        CATALOG.affixes().forEach(a->ids.add(a.id()));
+        assertEquals(160,ids.size());
+        return Set.copyOf(ids);
+    }
+    private static void rejected(GearInstance item,String reason,GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate candidate) {
+        var result=resolve(candidate);
+        assertEquals(reason,result.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(result.validItems().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(result.effects().snapshot().empty());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,result.effects());
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} equipment admission")
+    @ValueSource(strings={"WA-001","WA-002","WA-003","WA-004","WA-005","WA-006","WA-007","WA-008","WA-009","WA-010","WA-011","WA-012","WA-013","WA-014","WA-015","WA-016","WA-017","WA-018","WA-019","WA-020","WA-021","WA-022","WA-023","WA-024","WA-025","WA-026","WA-027","WA-028","WA-029","WA-030","WA-031","WA-032","WA-033","WA-034","WA-035","WA-036","WA-037","WA-038","WA-039","WA-040","WA-041","WA-042","WA-043","WA-044","WA-045","WA-046","WA-047","WA-048","WA-049","WA-050","WA-051","WA-052","WA-053","WA-054","WA-055","WA-056","WA-057","WA-058","WA-059","WA-060","WA-061","WA-062","WA-063","WA-064","WA-065","WA-066","WA-067","WA-068","WA-069","WA-070","WA-071","WA-072","WA-073","WA-074","WA-075","WA-076","WA-077","WA-078","WA-079","WA-080","WA-081","WA-082","WA-083","WA-084","WA-085","WA-086","WA-087","WA-088","WA-089","WA-090","WA-091","WA-092","WA-093","WA-094","WA-095","WA-096","WA-097","WA-098","WA-099","WA-100","WA-101","WA-102","WA-103","WA-104","WA-105","WA-106","WA-107","WA-108","WA-109","WA-110","WA-111","WA-112","WA-113","WA-114","WA-115","WA-116","WA-117","WA-118","WA-119","WA-120","WA-121","WA-122","WA-123","WA-124","WA-125","WA-126","WA-127","WA-128","WA-129","WA-130","WA-131","WA-132","WA-133","WA-134","WA-135","WA-136","WA-137","WA-138","WA-139","WA-140","WA-141","WA-142","WA-143","WA-144","WA-145","WA-146","WA-147","WA-148","WA-149","WA-150","WA-151","WA-152","WA-153","WA-154","WA-155","WA-156","WA-157","WA-158","GA-159","GA-160"})
+    void authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation(String id) {
+        String fixtureId="ab-"+id.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)+"-affixed";
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var item=QA.preview(row);
+        var base=CATALOG.base(item.baseId());
+        var definition=CATALOG.affix(id);
+        var roll=assertDoesNotThrow(()->item.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(List.of(id),item.affixes().stream().map(GearInstance.AffixRoll::familyId).toList());
+        assertEquals(row.itemLevel(),item.itemLevel());
+        assertEquals(5,HIGH.size());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),item.itemLevel()),id+" source window");
+        assertEquals(definition.side(),roll.side());
+        assertEquals(definition.exclusionGroup(),roll.exclusionGroup());
+        var tier=GearAffixTiers.compile(definition).stream().filter(t->t.tier()==roll.tier()).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        assertTrue(tier.minimumItemLevel()<=item.itemLevel());
+        assertTrue(GearAffixTiers.rarityAllows(definition,tier,item.rarity()));
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.rollable(definition,base,tier));
+        assertEquals(tier.requiredLevel(),roll.requirements().level());
+        assertEquals(GearRequirements.combine(new GearRequirements.Gate(base.requiredLevel(),base.requiredAttributes()),
+                List.of(roll.requirements()),id.equals("WA-154")
+                        ?java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(roll.value()).movePointLeft(2):java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO),item.requirements());
+        if(definition.eligibility().equals("MATCH"))
+            assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.matchingSkillIds(base).contains(roll.selector()),id+" frozen selector");
+        else assertNull(roll.selector());
+
+        var accepted=resolve(equipped(item));
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),accepted.validItems());
+        assertTrue(accepted.rejected().isEmpty());
+        var snapshot=accepted.effects().snapshot();
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),snapshot.items());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id));
+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var control=QA.preview(controlRow);
+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} production carrier legality: {1}")
+    @MethodSource("authoredAffixes")
+    void authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible(String id,String fixtureId) {
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var base=CATALOG.base(row.itemBaseId());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),row.itemLevel()),id+" authored source window");
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.eligible(CATALOG.affix(id),base),id+" has no legal carrier: "+base.id());
+    }
+}

+    void authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation(String id) {

+        var item=QA.preview(row);

+        assertEquals(row.itemLevel(),item.itemLevel());

+        assertTrue(tier.minimumItemLevel()<=item.itemLevel());
+        assertTrue(GearAffixTiers.rarityAllows(definition,tier,item.rarity()));
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.rollable(definition,base,tier));
+        assertEquals(tier.requiredLevel(),roll.requirements().level());
+        assertEquals(GearRequirements.combine(new GearRequirements.Gate(base.requiredLevel(),base.requiredAttributes()),
+                List.of(roll.requirements()),id.equals("WA-154")

+        else assertNull(roll.selector());
+

+        assertEquals(List.of(item),accepted.validItems());
+        assertTrue(accepted.rejected().isEmpty());
+        var snapshot=accepted.effects().snapshot();
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),snapshot.items());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id));
+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();

+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.combat.attribute.RpgAttribute;
+import java.util.*;
+import java.util.stream.Stream;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Candidate equipment proof only; it does not qualify an affix's gameplay consumer. */
+class MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest {
+    private static final GearCatalog CATALOG=GearCatalog.load();
+    private static final GearAffixQaSuite QA=new GearAffixQaSuite(CATALOG);
+    private static final Map<RpgAttribute,Integer> HIGH=Map.of(RpgAttribute.STR,500,RpgAttribute.DEX,500,
+            RpgAttribute.INT,500,RpgAttribute.WIS,500,RpgAttribute.LUCK,500);
+
+    static Stream<Arguments> authoredAffixes() {
+        assertEquals(160,QA.coverage().size());
+        return QA.coverage().stream().map(row->Arguments.of(row.affixId(),row.fixtureId()));
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate equipped(GearInstance item) {
+        return new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,true);
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Result resolve(GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate... slots) {
+        return GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(slots),ALL_AUTHORED);
+    }
+    private static final Set<String> ALL_AUTHORED=authoredIds();
+    private static Set<String> authoredIds() {
+        var ids=new HashSet<String>();
+        CATALOG.affixes().forEach(a->ids.add(a.id()));
+        assertEquals(160,ids.size());
+        return Set.copyOf(ids);
+    }
+    private static void rejected(GearInstance item,String reason,GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate candidate) {
+        var result=resolve(candidate);
+        assertEquals(reason,result.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(result.validItems().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(result.effects().snapshot().empty());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,result.effects());
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} equipment admission")
+    @ValueSource(strings={"WA-001","WA-002","WA-003","WA-004","WA-005","WA-006","WA-007","WA-008","WA-009","WA-010","WA-011","WA-012","WA-013","WA-014","WA-015","WA-016","WA-017","WA-018","WA-019","WA-020","WA-021","WA-022","WA-023","WA-024","WA-025","WA-026","WA-027","WA-028","WA-029","WA-030","WA-031","WA-032","WA-033","WA-034","WA-035","WA-036","WA-037","WA-038","WA-039","WA-040","WA-041","WA-042","WA-043","WA-044","WA-045","WA-046","WA-047","WA-048","WA-049","WA-050","WA-051","WA-052","WA-053","WA-054","WA-055","WA-056","WA-057","WA-058","WA-059","WA-060","WA-061","WA-062","WA-063","WA-064","WA-065","WA-066","WA-067","WA-068","WA-069","WA-070","WA-071","WA-072","WA-073","WA-074","WA-075","WA-076","WA-077","WA-078","WA-079","WA-080","WA-081","WA-082","WA-083","WA-084","WA-085","WA-086","WA-087","WA-088","WA-089","WA-090","WA-091","WA-092","WA-093","WA-094","WA-095","WA-096","WA-097","WA-098","WA-099","WA-100","WA-101","WA-102","WA-103","WA-104","WA-105","WA-106","WA-107","WA-108","WA-109","WA-110","WA-111","WA-112","WA-113","WA-114","WA-115","WA-116","WA-117","WA-118","WA-119","WA-120","WA-121","WA-122","WA-123","WA-124","WA-125","WA-126","WA-127","WA-128","WA-129","WA-130","WA-131","WA-132","WA-133","WA-134","WA-135","WA-136","WA-137","WA-138","WA-139","WA-140","WA-141","WA-142","WA-143","WA-144","WA-145","WA-146","WA-147","WA-148","WA-149","WA-150","WA-151","WA-152","WA-153","WA-154","WA-155","WA-156","WA-157","WA-158","GA-159","GA-160"})
+    void authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation(String id) {
+        String fixtureId="ab-"+id.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)+"-affixed";
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var item=QA.preview(row);
+        var base=CATALOG.base(item.baseId());
+        var definition=CATALOG.affix(id);
+        var roll=assertDoesNotThrow(()->item.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(List.of(id),item.affixes().stream().map(GearInstance.AffixRoll::familyId).toList());
+        assertEquals(row.itemLevel(),item.itemLevel());
+        assertEquals(5,HIGH.size());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),item.itemLevel()),id+" source window");
+        assertEquals(definition.side(),roll.side());
+        assertEquals(definition.exclusionGroup(),roll.exclusionGroup());
+        var tier=GearAffixTiers.compile(definition).stream().filter(t->t.tier()==roll.tier()).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        assertTrue(tier.minimumItemLevel()<=item.itemLevel());
+        assertTrue(GearAffixTiers.rarityAllows(definition,tier,item.rarity()));
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.rollable(definition,base,tier));
+        assertEquals(tier.requiredLevel(),roll.requirements().level());
+        assertEquals(GearRequirements.combine(new GearRequirements.Gate(base.requiredLevel(),base.requiredAttributes()),
+                List.of(roll.requirements()),id.equals("WA-154")
+                        ?java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(roll.value()).movePointLeft(2):java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO),item.requirements());
+        if(definition.eligibility().equals("MATCH"))
+            assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.matchingSkillIds(base).contains(roll.selector()),id+" frozen selector");
+        else assertNull(roll.selector());
+
+        var accepted=resolve(equipped(item));
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),accepted.validItems());
+        assertTrue(accepted.rejected().isEmpty());
+        var snapshot=accepted.effects().snapshot();
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),snapshot.items());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id));
+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var control=QA.preview(controlRow);
+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} production carrier legality: {1}")
+    @MethodSource("authoredAffixes")
+    void authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible(String id,String fixtureId) {
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var base=CATALOG.base(row.itemBaseId());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),row.itemLevel()),id+" authored source window");
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.eligible(CATALOG.affix(id),base),id+" has no legal carrier: "+base.id());
+    }

+import static org.junit.platform.engine.discovery.DiscoverySelectors.selectClass;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherFactory;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.listeners.SummaryGeneratingListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestExecutionListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestIdentifier;
+import org.junit.platform.engine.TestExecutionResult;
+
+public final class EquipmentSimulatorRunner {
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        var request=LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder.request()
+                .selectors(selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest"),
+                        selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEquipmentLifecycleTest")).build();
+        var listener=new SummaryGeneratingListener();
+        var invocations=new StringBuilder("uniqueId\tdisplayName\tstatus\n");
+        var launcher=LauncherFactory.create();
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(listener);
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(new TestExecutionListener() {
+            @Override public void executionFinished(TestIdentifier test,TestExecutionResult result) {
+                if(test.isTest()) invocations.append(test.getUniqueId()).append('\t')
+                        .append(test.getDisplayName()).append('\t').append(result.getStatus()).append('\n');
+            }
+        });
+        launcher.execute(request);
+        try {
+            java.nio.file.Files.writeString(java.nio.file.Path.of(
+                    "evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/invocations.tsv"),invocations);
+        } catch(java.io.IOException error) { throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(error); }
+        var summary=listener.getSummary();
+        summary.printTo(new java.io.PrintWriter(System.out,true));
+        summary.getFailures().forEach(f->System.out.println("FAIL "+f.getTestIdentifier().getDisplayName()
+                +": "+f.getException().getMessage()));
+        if(summary.getTestsFailedCount()!=0 || summary.getTestsFoundCount()<330) System.exit(1);
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.combat.attribute.RpgAttribute;
+import java.util.*;
+import java.util.stream.Stream;

+/** Candidate equipment proof only; it does not qualify an affix's gameplay consumer. */
+class MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest {

+    private static final GearAffixQaSuite QA=new GearAffixQaSuite(CATALOG);

+    static Stream<Arguments> authoredAffixes() {
+        assertEquals(160,QA.coverage().size());

+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate equipped(GearInstance item) {

+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Result resolve(GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate... slots) {
+        return GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(slots),ALL_AUTHORED);
+    }
+    private static final Set<String> ALL_AUTHORED=authoredIds();
+    private static Set<String> authoredIds() {
+        var ids=new HashSet<String>();
+        CATALOG.affixes().forEach(a->ids.add(a.id()));
+        assertEquals(160,ids.size());
+        return Set.copyOf(ids);
+    }
+    private static void rejected(GearInstance item,String reason,GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate candidate) {
+        var result=resolve(candidate);
+        assertEquals(reason,result.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(result.validItems().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(result.effects().snapshot().empty());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,result.effects());
+    }

+    @ValueSource(strings={"WA-001","WA-002","WA-003","WA-004","WA-005","WA-006","WA-007","WA-008","WA-009","WA-010","WA-011","WA-012","WA-013","WA-014","WA-015","WA-016","WA-017","WA-018","WA-019","WA-020","WA-021","WA-022","WA-023","WA-024","WA-025","WA-026","WA-027","WA-028","WA-029","WA-030","WA-031","WA-032","WA-033","WA-034","WA-035","WA-036","WA-037","WA-038","WA-039","WA-040","WA-041","WA-042","WA-043","WA-044","WA-045","WA-046","WA-047","WA-048","WA-049","WA-050","WA-051","WA-052","WA-053","WA-054","WA-055","WA-056","WA-057","WA-058","WA-059","WA-060","WA-061","WA-062","WA-063","WA-064","WA-065","WA-066","WA-067","WA-068","WA-069","WA-070","WA-071","WA-072","WA-073","WA-074","WA-075","WA-076","WA-077","WA-078","WA-079","WA-080","WA-081","WA-082","WA-083","WA-084","WA-085","WA-086","WA-087","WA-088","WA-089","WA-090","WA-091","WA-092","WA-093","WA-094","WA-095","WA-096","WA-097","WA-098","WA-099","WA-100","WA-101","WA-102","WA-103","WA-104","WA-105","WA-106","WA-107","WA-108","WA-109","WA-110","WA-111","WA-112","WA-113","WA-114","WA-115","WA-116","WA-117","WA-118","WA-119","WA-120","WA-121","WA-122","WA-123","WA-124","WA-125","WA-126","WA-127","WA-128","WA-129","WA-130","WA-131","WA-132","WA-133","WA-134","WA-135","WA-136","WA-137","WA-138","WA-139","WA-140","WA-141","WA-142","WA-143","WA-144","WA-145","WA-146","WA-147","WA-148","WA-149","WA-150","WA-151","WA-152","WA-153","WA-154","WA-155","WA-156","WA-157","WA-158","GA-159","GA-160"})
+    void authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation(String id) {
+        String fixtureId="ab-"+id.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)+"-affixed";
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var item=QA.preview(row);
+        var base=CATALOG.base(item.baseId());
+        var definition=CATALOG.affix(id);
+        var roll=assertDoesNotThrow(()->item.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(List.of(id),item.affixes().stream().map(GearInstance.AffixRoll::familyId).toList());
+        assertEquals(row.itemLevel(),item.itemLevel());
+        assertEquals(5,HIGH.size());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),item.itemLevel()),id+" source window");
+        assertEquals(definition.side(),roll.side());
+        assertEquals(definition.exclusionGroup(),roll.exclusionGroup());
+        var tier=GearAffixTiers.compile(definition).stream().filter(t->t.tier()==roll.tier()).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        assertTrue(tier.minimumItemLevel()<=item.itemLevel());
+        assertTrue(GearAffixTiers.rarityAllows(definition,tier,item.rarity()));
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.rollable(definition,base,tier));
+        assertEquals(tier.requiredLevel(),roll.requirements().level());
+        assertEquals(GearRequirements.combine(new GearRequirements.Gate(base.requiredLevel(),base.requiredAttributes()),
+                List.of(roll.requirements()),id.equals("WA-154")
+                        ?java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(roll.value()).movePointLeft(2):java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO),item.requirements());
+        if(definition.eligibility().equals("MATCH"))
+            assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.matchingSkillIds(base).contains(roll.selector()),id+" frozen selector");
+        else assertNull(roll.selector());
+
+        var accepted=resolve(equipped(item));
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),accepted.validItems());
+        assertTrue(accepted.rejected().isEmpty());
+        var snapshot=accepted.effects().snapshot();
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),snapshot.items());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id));
+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var control=QA.preview(controlRow);
+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} production carrier legality: {1}")
+    @MethodSource("authoredAffixes")
+    void authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible(String id,String fixtureId) {
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var base=CATALOG.base(row.itemBaseId());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),row.itemLevel()),id+" authored source window");
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.eligible(CATALOG.affix(id),base),id+" has no legal carrier: "+base.id());
+    }
+}

+import static org.junit.platform.engine.discovery.DiscoverySelectors.selectClass;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherFactory;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.listeners.SummaryGeneratingListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestExecutionListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestIdentifier;
+import org.junit.platform.engine.TestExecutionResult;
+
+public final class EquipmentSimulatorRunner {
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        var request=LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder.request()
+                .selectors(selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest"),
+                        selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEquipmentLifecycleTest")).build();
+        var listener=new SummaryGeneratingListener();
+        var invocations=new StringBuilder("uniqueId\tdisplayName\tstatus\n");
+        var launcher=LauncherFactory.create();
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(listener);
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(new TestExecutionListener() {
+            @Override public void executionFinished(TestIdentifier test,TestExecutionResult result) {
+                if(test.isTest()) invocations.append(test.getUniqueId()).append('\t')
+                        .append(test.getDisplayName()).append('\t').append(result.getStatus()).append('\n');
+            }
+        });
+        launcher.execute(request);
+        try {
+            java.nio.file.Files.writeString(java.nio.file.Path.of(
+                    "evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/invocations.tsv"),invocations);
+        } catch(java.io.IOException error) { throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(error); }
+        var summary=listener.getSummary();
+        summary.printTo(new java.io.PrintWriter(System.out,true));
+        summary.getFailures().forEach(f->System.out.println("FAIL "+f.getTestIdentifier().getDisplayName()
+                +": "+f.getException().getMessage()));
+        if(summary.getTestsFailedCount()!=0 || summary.getTestsFoundCount()<330) System.exit(1);
+    }
+}

+import static org.junit.platform.engine.discovery.DiscoverySelectors.selectClass;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherFactory;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.listeners.SummaryGeneratingListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestExecutionListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestIdentifier;
+import org.junit.platform.engine.TestExecutionResult;
+
+public final class EquipmentSimulatorRunner {
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        var request=LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder.request()
+                .selectors(selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest"),
+                        selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEquipmentLifecycleTest")).build();
+        var listener=new SummaryGeneratingListener();
+        var invocations=new StringBuilder("uniqueId\tdisplayName\tstatus\n");
+        var launcher=LauncherFactory.create();
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(listener);
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(new TestExecutionListener() {
+            @Override public void executionFinished(TestIdentifier test,TestExecutionResult result) {
+                if(test.isTest()) invocations.append(test.getUniqueId()).append('\t')
+                        .append(test.getDisplayName()).append('\t').append(result.getStatus()).append('\n');
+            }
+        });
+        launcher.execute(request);
+        try {
+            java.nio.file.Files.writeString(java.nio.file.Path.of(
+                    "evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/invocations.tsv"),invocations);
+        } catch(java.io.IOException error) { throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(error); }
+        var summary=listener.getSummary();
+        summary.printTo(new java.io.PrintWriter(System.out,true));
+        summary.getFailures().forEach(f->System.out.println("FAIL "+f.getTestIdentifier().getDisplayName()
+                +": "+f.getException().getMessage()));
+        if(summary.getTestsFailedCount()!=0 || summary.getTestsFoundCount()<330) System.exit(1);
+    }
+}

+import static org.junit.platform.engine.discovery.DiscoverySelectors.selectClass;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherFactory;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.listeners.SummaryGeneratingListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestExecutionListener;
+import org.junit.platform.launcher.TestIdentifier;
+import org.junit.platform.engine.TestExecutionResult;
+
+public final class EquipmentSimulatorRunner {
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        var request=LauncherDiscoveryRequestBuilder.request()
+                .selectors(selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest"),
+                        selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEquipmentLifecycleTest")).build();
+        var listener=new SummaryGeneratingListener();
+        var invocations=new StringBuilder("uniqueId\tdisplayName\tstatus\n");
+        var launcher=LauncherFactory.create();
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(listener);
+        launcher.registerTestExecutionListeners(new TestExecutionListener() {
+            @Override public void executionFinished(TestIdentifier test,TestExecutionResult result) {
+                if(test.isTest()) invocations.append(test.getUniqueId()).append('\t')
+                        .append(test.getDisplayName()).append('\t').append(result.getStatus()).append('\n');
+            }
+        });
+        launcher.execute(request);
+        try {
+            java.nio.file.Files.writeString(java.nio.file.Path.of(
+                    "evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/invocations.tsv"),invocations);
+        } catch(java.io.IOException error) { throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(error); }
+        var summary=listener.getSummary();
+        summary.printTo(new java.io.PrintWriter(System.out,true));
+        summary.getFailures().forEach(f->System.out.println("FAIL "+f.getTestIdentifier().getDisplayName()
+                +": "+f.getException().getMessage()));
+        if(summary.getTestsFailedCount()!=0 || summary.getTestsFoundCount()<330) System.exit(1);
+    }
+}

+                .selectors(selectClass("com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest"),

+                if(test.isTest()) invocations.append(test.getUniqueId()).append('\t')
+                        .append(test.getDisplayName()).append('\t').append(result.getStatus()).append('\n');
+            }
+        });

+                    "evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/invocations.tsv"),invocations);
+        } catch(java.io.IOException error) { throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(error); }
+        var summary=listener.getSummary();

+        summary.getFailures().forEach(f->System.out.println("FAIL "+f.getTestIdentifier().getDisplayName()
+                +": "+f.getException().getMessage()));

+    }

+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());

+

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.combat.attribute.RpgAttribute;
+import java.util.*;
+import java.util.stream.Stream;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Candidate equipment proof only; it does not qualify an affix's gameplay consumer. */
+class MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest {
+    private static final GearCatalog CATALOG=GearCatalog.load();
+    private static final GearAffixQaSuite QA=new GearAffixQaSuite(CATALOG);
+    private static final Map<RpgAttribute,Integer> HIGH=Map.of(RpgAttribute.STR,500,RpgAttribute.DEX,500,
+            RpgAttribute.INT,500,RpgAttribute.WIS,500,RpgAttribute.LUCK,500);
+
+    static Stream<Arguments> authoredAffixes() {
+        assertEquals(160,QA.coverage().size());
+        return QA.coverage().stream().map(row->Arguments.of(row.affixId(),row.fixtureId()));
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate equipped(GearInstance item) {
+        return new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,true);
+    }
+    private static GearEquipmentResolution.Result resolve(GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate... slots) {
+        return GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(slots),ALL_AUTHORED);
+    }
+    private static final Set<String> ALL_AUTHORED=authoredIds();
+    private static Set<String> authoredIds() {
+        var ids=new HashSet<String>();
+        CATALOG.affixes().forEach(a->ids.add(a.id()));
+        assertEquals(160,ids.size());
+        return Set.copyOf(ids);
+    }
+    private static void rejected(GearInstance item,String reason,GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate candidate) {
+        var result=resolve(candidate);
+        assertEquals(reason,result.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(result.validItems().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(result.effects().snapshot().empty());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,result.effects());
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} equipment admission")

+    void authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation(String id) {
+        String fixtureId="ab-"+id.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)+"-affixed";
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var item=QA.preview(row);
+        var base=CATALOG.base(item.baseId());
+        var definition=CATALOG.affix(id);
+        var roll=assertDoesNotThrow(()->item.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(List.of(id),item.affixes().stream().map(GearInstance.AffixRoll::familyId).toList());
+        assertEquals(row.itemLevel(),item.itemLevel());
+        assertEquals(5,HIGH.size());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),item.itemLevel()),id+" source window");
+        assertEquals(definition.side(),roll.side());
+        assertEquals(definition.exclusionGroup(),roll.exclusionGroup());
+        var tier=GearAffixTiers.compile(definition).stream().filter(t->t.tier()==roll.tier()).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        assertTrue(tier.minimumItemLevel()<=item.itemLevel());
+        assertTrue(GearAffixTiers.rarityAllows(definition,tier,item.rarity()));
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.rollable(definition,base,tier));
+        assertEquals(tier.requiredLevel(),roll.requirements().level());
+        assertEquals(GearRequirements.combine(new GearRequirements.Gate(base.requiredLevel(),base.requiredAttributes()),
+                List.of(roll.requirements()),id.equals("WA-154")
+                        ?java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(roll.value()).movePointLeft(2):java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO),item.requirements());
+        if(definition.eligibility().equals("MATCH"))
+            assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.matchingSkillIds(base).contains(roll.selector()),id+" frozen selector");
+        else assertNull(roll.selector());
+
+        var accepted=resolve(equipped(item));
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),accepted.validItems());
+        assertTrue(accepted.rejected().isEmpty());
+        var snapshot=accepted.effects().snapshot();
+        assertEquals(List.of(item),snapshot.items());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id));
+        assertEquals(List.of(roll),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .stream().map(GearEffectSnapshot.Source::roll).toList());
+        assertEquals(item.identity(),snapshot.sources(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator()))
+                .getFirst().itemId());
+        assertEquals(snapshot,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+        assertTrue(snapshot.forItem(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))).empty());
+
+        var reloaded=GearInstance.fromJson(item.toJson());
+        var afterReload=resolve(equipped(reloaded)).effects();
+        assertEquals(accepted.effects(),afterReload);
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),afterReload.snapshot().value(id));
+        assertEquals(snapshot.revision(),resolve(equipped(item)).effects().snapshot().revision());
+        assertEquals(roll,reloaded.affixes().getFirst());
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,resolve().effects());
+        assertEquals(roll.value(),snapshot.value(id),"earlier accepted snapshot remains frozen");
+
+        rejected(item,"NOT_EQUIPPED",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,false,true,true));
+        rejected(item,"BROKEN",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,false,true));
+        rejected(item,"WRONG_SLOT",new GearEquipmentResolution.Candidate(item,true,true,false));
+        var duplicate=resolve(equipped(item),equipped(reloaded));
+        assertEquals("DUPLICATE_IDENTITY",duplicate.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,duplicate.effects());
+        var unmet=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(1,Map.of(),List.of(equipped(item)),ALL_AUTHORED);
+        assertEquals("UNMET_REQUIREMENTS",unmet.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+        assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,unmet.effects());
+        assertFalse(item.requirements().failures(1,Map.of(),base.category()==GearCatalog.Category.ARMOR).isEmpty());
+
+        var controlRow=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId.replace("-affixed","-control")))
+                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var control=QA.preview(controlRow);
+        assertEquals(item.baseId(),control.baseId());
+        assertEquals(item.intrinsicStats(),control.intrinsicStats());
+        assertTrue(control.affixes().isEmpty());
+        assertTrue(resolve(equipped(control)).effects().snapshot().sources(
+                GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.valueOf(definition.operator())).isEmpty());
+        if(!GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED.contains(id)) {
+            var production=GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(99,HIGH,List.of(equipped(item)));
+            assertEquals("CAPABILITY_GATED",production.rejected().get(item.identity()));
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,production.effects());
+            assertEquals(GearAffixRuntime.Effects.NONE,GearAffixRuntime.effects(List.of(item)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} production carrier legality: {1}")
+    @MethodSource("authoredAffixes")
+    void authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible(String id,String fixtureId) {
+        var row=QA.fixtures().stream().filter(f->f.fixtureId().equals(fixtureId)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
+        var base=CATALOG.base(row.itemBaseId());
+        assertTrue(base.eligible(base.era(),row.itemLevel()),id+" authored source window");
+        assertTrue(GearDropGenerator.eligible(CATALOG.affix(id),base),id+" has no legal carrier: "+base.id());
+    }

+# Equipment simulator result (2026-09-30)
+
+## Scope and outcome
+
+- Candidate equipment admission and effects use the same package-private capability set. Public `GearEquipmentResolution.resolve`, `GearAffixRuntime.effects`, and `GearAffixRuntime.supported` still use the unchanged 21-ID `ENABLED` set. This is candidate qualification only, not functional gameplay qualification or a release-gate change.
+- `MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest#authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation`: **160/160 passing** distinct authored IDs. Each invocation uses `GearAffixQaSuite.preview` to construct a frozen roll and verifies authored source window, tier, rarity, gate, selector, real equipment admission at owner level 99 with five permanent attributes at 500, source-preserving accepted snapshot, exact affix value and item identity, JSON reload, unequip, backpack, broken, wrong slot, duplicate identity, unmet requirements, same-base unrolled control, and public capability rejection for IDs outside `ENABLED`.
+- `MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest#authoredCarrierIsProductionEligible`: **159/160 passing**. **WA-141 fails** on `gm.daggers_adamantite.h`: `GearDropGenerator.eligible` does not currently interpret the authored `M*` dagger eligibility token as legal. Main owns `GearDropGenerator`; it needs to admit the appropriate dagger `*` scope through the production eligibility gate without changing WA-141's authored values or requirements. Rerun this test after that change.
+- Existing `GearEquipmentLifecycleTest`: **10/10 passing**.
+- Combined direct JUnit run: **329 passed, 1 failed, 330 found**. The only failing invocation is WA-141 production carrier legality. [Run output](evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/run-output.txt) and [per-invocation IDs and statuses](evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/invocations.tsv) record the result. The [isolated runner](evidence/master-affix/equipment-simulator/Run-EquipmentSimulator.ps1) compiles only the owned files and runs JUnit directly, using existing compiled classes and resources for other dependencies. No Gradle, game, server, auth, deploy, or commit was run.
+
+## Proof registration for main
+
+The equipment authority candidate anchor is `com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.MasterAffixEquipmentSimulatorTest#authoredAffixReachesFrozenEquipmentSnapshotAndLeavesOnEveryInvalidation`. Its `@ValueSource` enumerates all 160 IDs literally, and each JUnit display name includes the ID. A per-ID `sourceAnchors.equippedAuthorityTest.parameterId` can point to this method after main obtains fresh normal JUnit XML; the current direct-run TSV is supplemental evidence, not the coverage generator's accepted XML. The test asserts the real `GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(...).effects().snapshot()` item source, value, and invalidation, rather than a fabricated snapshot or constant.
+
+Do not register this method as a gameplay `positiveTest`, `controlTest`, or `negativeTest` for an affix consumer. It proves equipment admission and removal only. The carrier legality method likewise does not prove a mapped native carrier or gameplay behavior.
+
+## Remaining limits
+
+- WA-141 cannot pass production carrier legality until main changes the dagger `*` eligibility interpretation. Its candidate equipment lifecycle invocation already passes.
+- `GearEffectSnapshot.revision()` can differ across JSON reload when map serialization order changes, although the item roll, `Effects`, and snapshot value remain equal. The simulator asserts stable revision for repeat resolution of the same frozen item and exact effects after reload; revision normalization belongs to the snapshot owner.
+- Advanced Stats and native gameplay consumers were outside this equipment-only ownership. No functional status follows from this run.
